sources.name: FIDE News
notes: Official source for FIDE events, championships, ratings, governance, and federation news.
Use short original summaries and link to canonical articles.

sources.name: Chess.com News
notes: Major global source for breaking chess stories, elite events, online events, and platform news.
Do not reproduce article text; redirect to the original source.

sources.name: ChessBase News
notes: Long-running chess media source for tournament reports, interviews, product news, and game analysis.
Avoid copying annotations or long excerpts.

sources.name: The Week in Chess
notes: Useful for tournament coverage, weekly news, PGN links, and results discovery.
Do not copy PGN collections.

sources.name: Lichess Blog
notes: Useful for Lichess platform updates, titled arenas, broadcasts, and open-source chess ecosystem news.
Keep platform news separate from tournament news when categorizing.

sources.name: Chessdom
notes: High-volume chess news site covering live games, interviews, tournament reports, photos, and social reactions.
Watch for duplicate stories already covered by official sources.

sources.name: New In Chess
notes: Magazine/editorial source for interviews, deep reports, podcasts, and premium-style chess journalism.
Flag paywall or rights uncertainty before approval.

sources.name: Take Take Take
notes: Useful for modern event recaps, player following, and mobile-first chess storytelling.
Prefer partnership clarity for repeated review.

sources.name: Chessable Blog
notes: Useful for educational chess news, product updates, opening articles, and Chessable ecosystem content.
Category should often be education or technology rather than tournament.

sources.name: ChessTech News
notes: Niche source for chess technology, tools, platforms, AI, broadcasting, and digital chess infrastructure.
Use technology category when appropriate.

sources.name: US Chess News
notes: Official US Chess news source for American events, scholastic chess, federation updates, and national tournaments.
Use as primary source for US federation stories.

sources.name: European Chess Union
notes: Official ECU source for European championships, federation announcements, youth events, and continental news.
Prefer official event pages when available.

sources.name: English Chess Federation
notes: Official English federation news.
Useful for team selections, ChessFest, youth events, arbiters, and national announcements.

sources.name: Federscacchi
notes: Official Italian federation source for national teams, youth events, championships, and federation communications.
Use Italian source attribution and short original summaries.

sources.name: Scacchierando
notes: Italian chess blog for national and international chess news.
Use for Italy-first discovery and commentary; avoid copying editorial text.

sources.name: FEDA
notes: Official Spanish federation news.
Useful for Spanish championships, youth events, circulars, and announcements.

sources.name: Europe Echecs
notes: Major French-language chess news source.
Flag paywall or image rights uncertainty when relevant.

sources.name: Deutscher Schachbund
notes: Official German federation source.
Useful for national teams, championships, and federation announcements.

sources.name: ChessBase India
notes: Strong Indian chess media source for players, tournaments, interviews, training stories, and youth chess.
Avoid copying interview passages or long story sections.

sources.name: All India Chess Federation
notes: Official Indian federation source for announcements, arbiters, ratings-related posts, and national events.
Use as primary source for federation notices.

sources.name: Chess Federation of Canada
notes: Official Canadian chess federation source.
Useful for Canadian news, players, federation notices, and newsletters.

sources.name: Reuters Chess
notes: High-authority mainstream source for major chess business, controversy, governance, and elite-event stories.
Often not chess-specific; verify story context before approval.

sources.name: Associated Press
notes: Useful for major international stories, obituaries, player profiles, and controversies.
Use canonical AP article URL when it is the original reporting source.

sources.name: The Guardian Chess
notes: Good for UK chess coverage, columns, puzzles, and public chess events.
Classify columns as opinion and avoid reproducing puzzle or column text.

sources.name: Financial Times Chess
notes: Occasional high-quality chess columns and cultural or business coverage.
Often paywalled; do not republish restricted content.

sources.name: Google News Search
notes: Discovery only.
Use to find stories, then verify and attribute the original publisher.

sources.name: Reddit r/chess
notes: Community signal and early discovery only.
Always verify with original sources before approval.

sources.name: X / Twitter official accounts
notes: Discovery only from official accounts for FIDE, platforms, federations, players, and organizers.
Prefer APIs or embeds and verify claims elsewhere before approval.

sources.name: YouTube chess channels
notes: Discovery for interviews, recaps, and player statements.
Do not scrape transcripts without checking rights.

sources.name: chess24
notes: Not an active primary source anymore.
Use Chess.com or archived chess24 content only when specifically relevant.

sources.name: Random repost blogs
notes: Often duplicate Chess.com, FIDE, ChessBase, or federation content without original reporting.
Do not use as primary source.

sources.name: Forums without moderation
notes: Useful for discovery in rare cases, but too noisy and unreliable for publication.
Require independent verification.

sources.name: Social media screenshots
notes: High risk of misinformation.
Verify with official source or original post before using any fact.
